{
  "kind": "regex",
  "entity_type": "INSURANCE_POLICY_NUMBER",
  "pattern": "\\bINS-[A-Z]{2}-\\d{4}-[A-Z]\\b",
  "rationale": "Matches insurance policy identifiers with the fixed literal prefix INS, two uppercase letters, four digits, and one trailing uppercase letter.",
  "positive_examples": [
    "INS-AB-1234-C",
    "INS-QX-0001-Z",
    "INS-MN-9876-A",
    "INS-TR-4520-K",
    "INS-JD-7000-R",
    "INS-LP-3141-B",
    "INS-VW-2468-Y",
    "INS-HC-9999-D"
  ],
  "negative_examples": [
    "INS-A-1234-C",
    "INS-AB-123-C",
    "INS-AB-12345-C",
    "INS-AB-1234",
    "INS-AB-1234-CD",
    "INX-AB-1234-C",
    "INS_AB_1234_C",
    "SKU-AB-1234-C",
    "v1.INS-AB-1234-C",
    "INS-AB-1234-c",
    "INS-AB-1234-C2"
  ],
  "taxonomy_term": {
    "domain": "insurance",
    "term": "insurance policy number",
    "definition": "A structured identifier for an insurance policy, consisting of the literal prefix INS, two uppercase letters, four digits, and a final uppercase letter."
  },
  "playbook_suggestion": {
    "agent_pair": "intake->claims",
    "action": "tokenize"
  }
}
